en: Easier said than done, Boss. You\rdidn't leave me anything to work with.\f
cz: To se lehko rekne, sefe. Nenechal\rjsi mi s cim delat.\f

en: Don't get saucy!\rRally the troops and do something!\fI have to go and pay him my respects.\fDon't fail me, Grit!\f
cz: Nedrz hubu tak nahoru!\rSeber vojsko a udelej neco!\fMusim mu jit vzdat hold.\fNezklam me, Grit!\f

en: Well, I'll be a... Olaf just tucked his\rtail between his legs and ran away.\fWhere does that leave me?\fGuess I'll mosey on down and\rclean up his mess.\f
cz: No to me podrz... Olaf stahl ocas\rmezi nohy a vzal do zajecich.\fA co ja ted?\fAsi se tam dokodrcam a uklidim\rten jeho svincik.\f

en: Too bad. The enemy captured twelve\rproperties first and won.\f
cz: Smula. Nepritel obsadil dvanact\rbudov driv a vyhral.\f

en: Reefs here, woods there,\rhiding places everywhere...\fMan, this place was made for Grit\rand his indirect-combat units.\fI really just want to rush in and\rget to stompin', but...\fThe smart thing to do is to use\rthe terrain and creep up on 'em.\fYep, that's the best plan.\rLet's move out!\f
cz: Tady utesy, tamhle lesy,\rkryt na kazdem kroku...\fClovece, tohle je delane pro Grita\ra jeho neprimou strelbu.\fNejradsi bych se tam vrhnul a\rdupal po nich, jenze...\fChytre je vyuzit teren a\rpomalu se k nim priplizit.\fJo, to je nejlepsi plan.\rVyrazime!\f

en: Well, here I am again.\fThis whole thing don't sit well with me,\rbut I guess I gotta stop foolin' around.\fI figure the best way to stop these\rboys is to take out their lander.\fYeah, that'll keep 'em from movin'\rthose ground troops around.\fReckon I'd best get started.\f
cz: Tak jsem zase tady.\fCelou tuhle vec mam proti srsti,\rale uz musim prestat lelkovat.\fNejlepsi zpusob, jak ty hochy\rzastavit, je sundat jim vysadkovou lod.\fJo, pak uz ty pozemni jednotky\rnikam neprevezou.\fRadsi se do toho dam.\f

en: OK, Grit! Now you're going to\ranswer some questions!\fWhy in blazes did you\rgo over to Blue Moon?\f
cz: Tak jo, Grit! Ted budes\rodpovidat na otazky!\fProc ses ksakru pridal\rk Blue Moon?\f

en: Grit!\f
cz: Grit!\f

en: Nell? What are you doing here?\f
cz: Nell? Co tady delas?\f

en: Hey there, Nell. It's been a long time.\f
cz: Ahoj, Nell. Dlouho jsme se nevideli.\f

en: Max. Would you please\rleave us alone for a minute?\f
cz: Max. Mohl bys nas na chvili\rnechat o samote?\f

en: Yeah... Sure...\f
cz: Jo... Jasne...\f

en: You look well. I was worried.\f
cz: Vypadas dobre. Mela jsem strach.\f

en: Yeah, I'm doin' all right.\fHow about you?\rYou and Max getting along all right?\f
cz: Jo, mam se docela fajn.\fA co ty?\rVychazite s Maxem v pohode?\f

en: So that's the reason you left\rOrange Star.\fYou sensed Max's feelings, and\rbecause he's your friend, you...\f
cz: Takze proto jsi odesel\rz Orange Star.\fVycitil jsi, co Max citi, a\rprotoze je to tvuj pritel, tak...\f

en: Whoa! Hold on, now. Let me\rset you straight.\fI did what I did 'cause that's\rwho I am, darlin'.\fI go where I want to go, and stay\rwhere I want to stay. That's it.\f
cz: Hola! Zadrz. Rovnou ti to\rvysvetlim.\fUdelal jsem to proto, ze\rtakovej proste jsem, zlaticko.\fChodim, kam chci, a zustavam\rtam, kde chci. A to je vsechno.\f

en: Oh, I...\f
cz: Ach, ja...\f

en: See you later, Nell. Take care.\f
cz: Tak zatim, Nell. Opatruj se.\f

en: Grit...\fGoodbye.\f
cz: Grit...\fSbohem.\f

en: Those look like Green Earth troops.\fI've heard they have an independent\rbattalion around. Maybe this is it.\fThey're supposed to be really tough.\rEspecially the air units.\f
cz: Vypadaji jako vojska Green Earth.\fPry tu nekde maji samostatny\rprapor. Mozna je to prave tenhle.\fMaji byt hodne tvrdi.\rHlavne jejich letectvo.\f

en: That's a Special Forces\rcommander for you!\fAlways up on the latest intel.\f
cz: To je velitel specialnich\rjednotek, jak ma byt!\fVzdycky ma cerstve informace.\f

en: But how did you get this\rintel, Andy?\f
cz: Ale jak jsi k tem informacim\rprisel, Andy?\f

en: I ran into 'em once, and...\f
cz: Jednou jsem na ne narazil a...\f

en: Hey, you survived, didn't you?\fThat's pretty impressive, Andy.\f
cz: Hele, prezil jsi to, ne?\fTo je dost dobre, Andy.\f

en: Yeah, Nice work, Andy.\fAll right, let's roll!\f
cz: Jo, dobra prace, Andy.\fTak jo, jedem!\f

en: The Orange Star Army...\rAndy's troops.\f
cz: Armada Orange Star...\rAndyho vojska.\f

en: This time, I won't be beaten\rby Andy and his ilk.\fI shall crush them with one stroke!\f
cz: Tentokrat me Andy a jemu\rpodobni neporazi.\fRozdrtim je jedinou ranou!\f

en: I, Eagle, beaten by Andy, again?\f
cz: Ja, Eagle, znovu porazen Andym?\f

en: Who are you calling Andy?\f
cz: Komu to rikas Andy?\f

en: Eh?\f
cz: Coze?\f

en: I think I'll take offense at your\rmistake. Do I look like a boy to you?\f
cz: Ten tvuj omyl me trochu urazil.\rVypadam snad jako kluk?\f

en: Who are you?\f
cz: Kdo jsi?\f

en: The name's Sami.\fI'm an Orange Star CO.\f
cz: Jmenuju se Sami.\fJsem velitelka Orange Star.\f

en: I... I lost to...a girl?\f
cz: Ja... prohral jsem s...divkou?\f

en: You're careless. That's why\ryou keep losing!\fI don't think you're ready for war.\rYou need to go back to basic training!\f
cz: Jsi nepozorny. Proto porad\rprohravas!\fNa valku jeste nejsi zraly.\rVrat se na zakladni vycvik!\f

en: Excuse me, Orange Star CO...Sami?\f
cz: Prominte, velitelko Orange Star...Sami?\f

en: Yes?\f
cz: Ano?\f

en: I would like to apologize for my\rbehavior. It was inappropriate.\f
cz: Rad bych se omluvil za sve\rchovani. Bylo nemistne.\f

en: Oh, OK...\f
cz: Aha, dobre...\f

en: I vow by my lucky goggles that the\rnext time we meet, I will do better.\f
cz: Prisaham pri svych brylich, ze\rpriste si povedu lepe.\f

en: Now I will take my leave. Farewell.\f
cz: Nyni se poroucim. Sbohem.\f

en: Wait, wait a minute!\fNo one said you could leave. Come...\fHe's gone!\f
cz: Pockej, pockej chvilku!\fNikdo ti nerekl, ze muzes odejit...\fJe pryc!\f

en: He seems like a pretty\rdecent guy, after all.\f
cz: Nakonec vypada jako docela\rslusnej chlap.\f

en: I, Eagle, lost again?\f
cz: Ja, Eagle, znovu porazen?\f

en: Yeah, it sure looks like it!\f
cz: Jo, tak to vypada!\f

en: You're the Orange Star CO?\rWhere's Andy?\f
cz: Ty jsi velitel Orange Star?\rKde je Andy?\f

en: Andy? Listen up, pal. I'm Max.\rThe best Orange Star has to offer!\f
cz: Andy? Poslouchej, kamarade. Ja jsem Max.\rTo nejlepsi, co Orange Star ma!\f

en: I'd heard of a CO who was as strong\ras a bull but a bit one-dimensional.\fWho could have foreseen that\rI would lose to him?\f
cz: Slysel jsem o veliteli silnem\rjako byk, ale trochu jednostrunnem.\fKdo mohl tusit, ze s nim\rprohraju?\f

en: What? What did you say?\f
cz: Coze? Co jsi to rekl?\f

en: I don't think you're ready for war!\f
cz: Na valku podle me jeste nejsi zraly!\f

en: Who... Who are you?\f
cz: Kdo... Kdo jsi?\f

en: Hold it!\rWhat about me is one-dimensional?\f
cz: Zadrz!\rCo je na mne jednostrunneho?\f

en: You stink at indirect combat.\f
cz: Jsi mizerny v neprime strelbe.\f

en: Rrr...\f
cz: Grr...\f

en: Yes?\f
cz: Ano?\f

en: I would like to apologize for my\rbehavior. It was inappropriate.\f
cz: Rad bych se omluvil za sve\rchovani. Bylo nemistne.\f

en: Oh, OK...\f
cz: Aha, dobre...\f

en: I vow by my lucky goggles that the\rnext time we meet, I will do better.\f
cz: Prisaham pri svych brylich, ze\rpriste si povedu lepe.\f

en: Now I will take my leave. Farewell\f
cz: Nyni se poroucim. Sbohem\f

en: Wait! Wait a minute!\rNo one said you could leave. Come...\f
cz: Pockej! Pockej chvilku!\rNikdo ti nerekl, ze muzes odejit...\f

en: He seems like a pretty\rdecent guy after all.\f
cz: Nakonec vypada jako docela\rslusnej chlap.\f

en: I, Eagle, lost again?\f
cz: Ja, Eagle, znovu porazen?\f

en: Yeah. I don't think you're\rready for war!\f
cz: Jo. Na valku podle me jeste\rnejsi zraly!\f

en: Who... Who are you?\f
cz: Kdo... Kdo jsi?\f

en: The name's Sami.\fI'm an Orange Star CO!\f
cz: Jmenuju se Sami.\fJsem velitelka Orange Star!\f

en: I cannot believe I lost to\rthis group of unseasoned...\f
cz: Nemohu uverit, ze jsem prohral\rs touhle bandou zelenacu...\f

en: You're careless! That's why\ryou keep losing!\fWe're an experienced group of\rCOs here, you know!\fYou need to go back to basic\rtraining and start again.\f
cz: Jsi nepozorny! Proto porad\rprohravas!\fJsme tu ostrileni velitele,\raby bylo jasno!\fVrat se na zakladni vycvik\ra zacni od zacatku.\f

en: Excuse me, Orange Star CO...Sami?\f
cz: Prominte, velitelko Orange Star...Sami?\f

en: Yes?\f
cz: Ano?\f

en: I would like to apologize for my\rbehavior. It was inappropriate.\f
cz: Rad bych se omluvil za sve\rchovani. Bylo nemistne.\f

en: Oh, OK...\f
cz: Aha, dobre...\f

en: I vow by my lucky goggles that the\rnext time we meet, I will do better.\f
cz: Prisaham pri svych brylich, ze\rpriste si povedu lepe.\f

en: Now I will take my leave. Farewell.\f
cz: Nyni se poroucim. Sbohem.\f

en: Wait! Wait a minute!\fNo one said you could leave. Come...\fHe's gone!\f
cz: Pockej! Pockej chvilku!\fNikdo ti nerekl, ze muzes odejit...\fJe pryc!\f

en: He seems like a pretty\rdecent guy after all.\f
cz: Nakonec vypada jako docela\rslusnej chlap.\f

en: Oh, no... I was just planning on\rpassing through Yellow Comet, but...\fKanbei's Imperial Forces spotted us\rbefore we even crossed the border.\f
cz: Ale ne... Chteli jsme jen projit\rpres Yellow Comet, jenze...\fKanbeiho cisarske sily nas objevily\rdriv, nez jsme presli hranici.\f

en: Kanbei's Imperial Forces?\f
cz: Kanbeiho cisarske sily?\f

en: Uh-huh. They're supposed to be\rthe best-trained troops around.\fThe high equipment costs and salaries\rmust make them hard to maintain.\f
cz: Presne. Pry jsou to nejlip\rvycvicena vojska siroko daleko.\fDrahe vybaveni a vysoke zoldy\rje musi stat hotovy majlant.\f

en: The best trained, huh?\rThis should be fun!\f
cz: Nejlip vycviceni, jo?\rTo bude zabava!\f

en: I don't think you'll have any\renergy left over for fun, Andy.\fC'mon, show me what you can do!\f
cz: Nemyslim, ze ti na zabavu\rzbydou sily, Andy.\fNo tak, ukaz, co umis!\f

en: Oh, no... I was just planning on\rpassing through Yellow Comet, but...\fKanbei's Imperial Forces spotted us\rbefore we even crossed the border.\f
cz: Ale ne... Chteli jsme jen projit\rpres Yellow Comet, jenze...\fKanbeiho cisarske sily nas objevily\rdriv, nez jsme presli hranici.\f

en: Kanbei's Imperial Forces?\f
cz: Kanbeiho cisarske sily?\f

en: Uh-huh. They're supposed to be\rthe best-trained troops around.\fThe high equipment costs and salaries\rmust make them hard to maintain.\f
cz: Presne. Pry jsou to nejlip\rvycvicena vojska siroko daleko.\fDrahe vybaveni a vysoke zoldy\rje musi stat hotovy majlant.\f

en: Oh, no... I was just planning on\rpassing through Yellow Comet, but...\fKanbei's Imperial Forces spotted us\rbefore we even crossed the border.\f
cz: Ale ne... Chteli jsme jen projit\rpres Yellow Comet, jenze...\fKanbeiho cisarske sily nas objevily\rdriv, nez jsme presli hranici.\f

en: Kanbei's Imperial Forces?\f
cz: Kanbeiho cisarske sily?\f

en: Uh-huh. They're supposed to be\rthe best-trained troops around.\fThe high equipment costs and salaries\rmust make them hard to maintain.\f
cz: Presne. Pry jsou to nejlip\rvycvicena vojska siroko daleko.\fDrahe vybaveni a vysoke zoldy\rje musi stat hotovy majlant.\f

en: The best trained, huh?\fBoy, Sami, you have all the fun!\rI wish I was going instead of you.\f
cz: Nejlip vycviceni, jo?\fSami, ty si uzijes vsechnu zabavu!\rKez bych tam sel misto tebe.\f

en: Preposterous!\fKanbei's forces...defeated?\fWithdraw!\f
cz: Nehoraznost!\fKanbeiho sily...porazeny?\fUstup!\f

en: Preposterous!\fSo many of Kanbei's forces defeated\rin such a short time?\fWithdraw!\f
cz: Nehoraznost!\fTolik Kanbeiho sil porazeno\rza tak kratky cas?\fUstup!\f

en: You'll have to take damage in order\rto take out the indirect combat units.\fAfter that, just stay within the\rmountains and protect your position.\fThe enemy will keep coming at you,\rbut you just have to hold on.\fDon't give up!\rGood luck!\f
cz: Bez zraneni jednotky neprime\rstrelby nezlikvidujes.\fPotom uz jen zustan v horach\ra chran svou pozici.\fNepritel bude utocit dal,\rale ty musis vydrzet.\fNevzdavej to!\rHodne stesti!\f

en: Hey!\fWhere's the rest of the army?\f
cz: Hej!\fKde je zbytek armady?\f

en: I'm sorry, Andy.\fThere was an error, and\rpreparations weren't completed.\f
cz: Omlouvam se, Andy.\fDoslo k chybe a pripravy\rnebyly dokonceny.\f

en: But there are bases for deployment.\fYou know how to use them, right?\f
cz: Ale jsou tu zakladny pro nasazeni.\fVite, jak je pouzit, ze?\f

en: Sure, I'm OK!\f
cz: Jasne, to zvladnu!\f

en: Hey, Nell!\fWhat's with this small battalion?\fIt's like you're asking me to lose!\f
cz: Hej, Nell!\fCo je tohle za maly prapor?\fTo si primo rikas o prohru!\f

en: I'm sorry, Max.\fThere was an error, and\rpreparations weren't completed.\f
cz: Omlouvam se, Max.\fDoslo k chybe a pripravy\rnebyly dokonceny.\f

en: But there are bases for\rdeployment, right there.\f
cz: Ale rovnou tamhle jsou\rzakladny pro nasazeni.\f

en: All right!\fI've got permission to request\rmy own units, right?\f
cz: Tak jo!\fMuzu si vyzadat vlastni\rjednotky, ze jo?\f

en: That's right.\fYou can deploy any unit\rthat you deem necessary.\fDo you remember the procedure?\f
cz: Presne tak.\fMuzete nasadit jakoukoli\rjednotku, kterou uznate za nutnou.\fPamatujete si postup?\f

en: Hey! Don't treat me like a fool!\fOf course I remember!\f
cz: Hej! Nedelej ze me hlupaka!\fJasne, ze si pamatuju!\f

en: There aren't many units here.\f
cz: Neni tu moc jednotek.\f

en: But then, there must be some\rbases around here. Right, Nell?\f
cz: Ale to tu nekde musi byt\rzakladny. Vid, Nell?\f

en: Right as always, Sami!\rNothing gets by you.\fI'm sure I don't have to tell\ryou what to do, right?\f
cz: Jako vzdy spravne, Sami!\rNic ti neunikne.\fUrcite ti nemusim rikat,\rco delat, ze?\f

en: No, I don't have any questions.\f
cz: Ne, nemam zadne otazky.\f

en: Where are all these enemy\runits coming from?\fWithdraw!\f
cz: Odkud se berou vsechny ty\rnepratelske jednotky?\fUstup!\f

en: This is beyond comprehension!\fRegardless of the odds, Kanbei\rshould never lose this many units!\fWithdraw!\f
cz: To je nad moje chapani!\fAt je presila jakakoli, Kanbei\rnesmi ztratit tolik jednotek!\fUstup!\f

en: Kanbei's got us surrounded!\f
cz: Kanbei nas obklicil!\f

en: On top of that, we have to\rseize properties to win.\fLooks like things are\rgonna get rough.\f
cz: A k tomu musime pro vitezstvi\robsadit budovy.\fVypada to, ze bude\rperne.\f

en: But look! This time we have\ran airport!\f
cz: Ale hele! Tentokrat mame\rletiste!\f

en: What's an airport, again?\f
cz: A co ze to letiste dela?\f

en: Airports let us deploy air units!\fPlus, damaged planes and copters\rcan go there to recover HP.\f
cz: Na letisti nasazujeme letadla!\fA poskozene stroje a vrtulniky\rsi tam doplni HP.\f

en: Oh, OK. Got it!\f
cz: Aha, jasne. Chapu!\f

en: That's cool, but isn't that Kanbei's\rbase right there?\f
cz: Fajn, ale neni tamhle\rKanbeiho zakladna?\f

en: Oh, ho ho ho!\fLook what I have found!\rA base for Kanbei's troops!\fI shall deploy a mountain\rof troops!\f
cz: Ho ho ho!\fPodivejme, co jsem nasel!\rZakladna pro Kanbeiho vojska!\fNasadim celou horu\rvojaku!\f

en: By my sword!\fWhat a horribly useless\rbase that was!\f
cz: Pri mem meci!\fJak strasne k nicemu\rta zakladna byla!\f

en: Oh, Father!\fYou know this is because you never\rlet me finish what I'm trying to tell you!\f
cz: Ach, otce!\fTo mas z toho, ze me nikdy\rnenechas domluvit!\f

en: But... But... Sonja, I...\f
cz: Ale... Ale... Sonja, ja...\f

en: And one more thing.\fOrange Star's objective is not\rto conquer Yellow Comet.\f
cz: A jeste jedna vec.\fCilem Orange Star neni\rdobyt Yellow Comet.\f

en: Are you mad, daughter?\fThey were...\f
cz: Zblaznila ses, dcero?\fVzdyt oni...\f

en: Father! Shooting first and asking\rquestions later is not a good strategy.\fIf you were suddenly attacked,\ryou'd return fire, too!\f
cz: Otce! Nejdriv strilet a pak se\rptat neni dobra strategie.\fKdyby nekdo napadl tebe,\rtaky bys opetoval palbu!\f

en: Well, I...\f
cz: No, ja...\f

en: If you leave them be, I'm sure\rthey'll depart without any trouble.\fNo more attacking, Father!\rUnderstood?\f
cz: Kdyz je nechas byt, urcite\rodejdou bez problemu.\fZadne dalsi utoky, otce!\rRozumis?\f

en: Um...\f
cz: Ehm...\f

en: Hmm... The Orange Star Army...\fThey're not all that I imagined\rthey would be.\fAs that's the case...\fit's up to me to act.\f
cz: Hmm... Armada Orange Star...\fNejsou uplne takovi, jak\rjsem si predstavovala.\fKdyz je to tak...\fmusim zasahnout sama.\f

en: By my sword!\fWhat a horribly useless\rbase that was!\fAnd I was defeated in such\ra short time!\fWas that base in a poor location?\f
cz: Pri mem meci!\fJak strasne k nicemu\rta zakladna byla!\fA porazili me za tak\rkratky cas!\fStala ta zakladna spatne?\f

en: You let fifteen properties get\rcaptured, didn't you?\f
cz: Nechal jsi obsadit patnact\rbudov, ze?\f

en: Sami's comments were dead-on.\fYou should've ignored that one base\rand focused on capturing others.\fIf you stay cool and calm,\ryou'll be fine.\fGood luck!\f
cz: Sami to rekla presne.\fMel jsi tu jednu zakladnu nechat\rbyt a obsazovat ostatni.\fKdyz zustanes v klidu,\rzvladnes to.\fHodne stesti!\f

en: Max, you have underdeveloped\rindirect-combat skills.\fYou compensate for this weakness\rwith a predilection for direct combat.\fIn areas where you can attack\rwith multiple units, you're a titan.\f
cz: Max, v neprime strelbe mas\rznacne mezery.\fTu slabinu si vynahrazujes\rzalibou v primem boji.\fTam, kde muzes utocit vice\rjednotkami, jsi obr.\f

en: Wha...?\f
cz: Coze...?\f

en: Who... Who are you?\f
cz: Kdo... Kdo jsi?\f

en: It's a pleasure to meet you.\rMy name is Sonja.\fI'm a Yellow Comet CO.\fI've taken the liberty of separating\ryou from your companions.\fSo, now...\f
cz: Tesi me, ze te poznavam.\rJmenuji se Sonja.\fJsem velitelka Yellow Comet.\fDovolila jsem si te oddelit\rod tvych druhu.\fA ted...\f

en: Sweet dreams, Max.\f
cz: Sladke sny, Max.\f
